title: CulturalTeaming: AI-Assisted Interactive Red-Teaming for Challenging LLMs’ (Lack of) Multicultural Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' accuracy using zero-shot prompting on CULTURALBENCH-V0.1, a dataset of multiple-choice questions regarding diverse cultural norms, practices, and etiquette, generated through AI-assisted interactive human red-teaming.
